title: Care Centre Guidance: After-Hours Premium Share on Harbison Labor-Only Protection Claims
content:
**The rule.** On a claim against a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the share of the after-hours premium paid depends on the call class of the claim's service call, as recorded under Repair and Emergency Service Calls:

| Call class of the claim's service call | Premium share |
|---|---|
| Overnight Emergency Service Call or Holiday Emergency Service Call | 1.00 |
| Evening Service Call or Weekend Service Call | 0.50 |
| any other call class | the tier's own after-hours coverage: one where the tier covers the after-hours premium, zero where it does not |

**How the share is applied.** The premium payable is the premium net multiplied by the premium share, and it is paid only on the lead claim of the service call — the claim whose failed component carries the largest repair labor line charged on that call. The premium net is the after-hours premium charged on that call less the member premium discount posted against it.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical, premium net $150.00 on the lead claim).**

- Holiday Emergency Service Call: share 1.00, premium payable $150.00.
- Weekend Service Call: share 0.50, premium payable $75.00.
- Standard Service Call on a tier that does not cover the after-hours premium: share zero, premium payable $0.00.
- Overnight Emergency Service Call, but the claim is the second claim on the call with the smaller labor line: not the lead claim, premium payable $0.00.
